'''Mol Hedron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] from [[Swarquen]]. Serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he went to ground after [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He later reappeared on [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] stealing information regarding the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] being built there. Eluding capture, he was able to transmit the information he gained to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].
